# Quartz microgrid

The fictional Quartz microgrid combines a 12-megawatt solar array with a
6-megawatt-hour battery. The array covers 18 hectares. During a regional outage
it can island essential loads for up to 9 hours. Its protected loads include
essential circuits at the Cedar Loop depot and the Lumen Library North Annex.
Battery state of charge is held above 30 percent in winter. Surplus power is
exported to the Meridian water system's pumping station. The corpus does not
state an installation date, construction cost, vendor, or ownership history.
